operations: Normalize weapon canvases to 2048 x 1024 and effects to 1024 x 1024.
Clean alpha values at or below 8 to 0 and at or above 252 to 255 while preserving intermediate edge antialiasing; zero RGB for fully transparent pixels.
Align weapon artwork to a common normalized canvas anchor and shared cuff/sleeve registration.

root-prompts.json.masterPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE final production PNG game sprite for FLICK: weapon 01 FINGER FLICK, LOADED. Input image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match the office cartoon's simple flat shape language, warm muted colors and dark brown uniform outlines. Do not reproduce any scenery or text.
Canvas: exactly 2048 x 1024 pixels, landscape 2:1, TRUE transparent background. One isolated hand-and-sleeve assembly. Large intentional empty space at left so this aligns with later long weapons. Strict 2D orthographic SIDE PROFILE, aiming perfectly horizontally LEFT; no tilt, no foreshortening, no perspective.
Player's RIGHT hand, light warm skin matching reference, realistic adult anatomy, four fingers and one thumb. Hand occupies right third only: skin approximately x=1360..1800. Wrist centered near (1770,655). Navy-blue dress-shirt forearm enters horizontally from right and continues off right edge. White cuff centered x=1840, y=655, one small button. Sleeve approximately y=550..770 at right edge. Fixed anchors must be respected. Finger gun gesture: index finger extends dead horizontally LEFT to x=1360 at y=455; thumb rises straight vertically UP near x=1690 with tip near y=300; remaining three fingers clearly curled into palm near (1610,610). Natural knuckles, nail on thumb, small visible fingernails, clean adult proportions.
LOADED band: exactly one ordinary tan rubber band hooks over LEFT fingertip, stretches diagonally back and UP to hook behind tip of raised thumb. Show the stretched loop as TWO very thin parallel tan strands with slightly darker brown outlines. It must connect fingertip to raised thumb tip, not wrist or palm.
Style: clean vector cartoon like polished indie game, bold even dark-brown outlines approx 8 px, crisp flat fills, only ONE soft-edged cel shadow tone and small highlight. Warm muted palette: skin #F2C9A0, shadow #DCAA82, outlines #332A24, navy #293D57, off-white cuff #F3EFE4, band #CDA66D. Light from upper left. No realistic rendering or painterly texture. Whole hand fits with clear vertical margin; ONLY sleeve cropped at right edge. Return this one asset only.
